verdict.rationale: Dataplex data lineage is documented as showing where data comes from, where it travels, and the transformations along the way, which covers the lineage half of the story at a general level. The pack has no evidence of audit logs recording who ran which queries, and nothing says lineage is tracked at column granularity. Missing for 10: audit logs of who ran what, column-level lineage evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
